newsitem.title: USA: NBC has no comment on GM Olympics report.
newsitem.headline: NBC has no comment on GM Olympics report.

text.p: General Electric Co's NBC Inc unit Monday had no comment on a New York Times report that General Motors Corp will announce an agreement for a long-term sponsorship of the United States Olympic Committee.
The deal, which would be worth several hundred million dollars, would run through the 2008 Summer Olympics, the report said.
NBC has broadcast rights to the Olympics, beginning with the 2000 Summer Olympics in Sydney, Australia through 2008.

The three parties were still negotiating the full value of the sponsorship in terms of commercial television time, fees to the Olympic Committee, promotional spending and products contributed by GM, the paper said.
GM and Olympics officials also declined to comment on the report.
